personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, technical command-center blending serious automotive HUD aesthetics with a precise developer diagnostics dashboard.

spacing.rule: Dense information architecture with highly visible, tactile touch targets. Keep data rows tight but navigation controls generous.

do's: Use heavy glass on the HUD data panels floating over the map on the Navigation screen.
Pair blur with ≥75% opacity dark tint (surfaceSecondary) to ensure the white mono text is always readable over the map.
Apply to the bottom tab bar.
dont's: Do not use blur on the dense Diagnostics screen; stick to solid dark surfaces for metric readability.
Do not blur primary action buttons.

screens.name: Navigation
screens.purpose: Live map view with integrated HUD for speed, GNSS status, and dead-reckoning metrics.

states.loading: Centered dark spinner with 'Initializing Sensor Fusion...'
states.empty: No map data fallback with GNSS searching animation
states.error: Red outage screen asking to verify Member 5 engine connection.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map background. Top overlay: GNSS/Dead Reckoning status pill (Green/Amber/Red based on status) and accuracy in meters. Bottom 40% of screen: Glassmorphism HUD panel containing large (3xl) mono speed readout (km/h), heading compass, position coordinates, and map coverage state. Floating action button for centering map.

screens.name: Diagnostics
screens.purpose: Developer telemetry dashboard for sensor Hz, timestamps, and engine status.

states.empty: N/A - diagnostics should always show zeros or real data.

screens.layout: Scrollable list view with solid backgrounds (no glass). Use IBM Plex Mono for all numeric readouts. Data rows for Accel Hz, Gyro Hz, and timestamp deltas. Small warning/error badges for dropped or stale samples. Section for Member 5 Engine Status and Member 4 Map-Match Status. Emphasize contrast between labels (muted) and values (onSurface/brand).

screens.name: Simulation
screens.purpose: Dev-only synthetic drive scenarios and regression triggers.
screens.layout: Settings-style layout. Full-width rows with toggle switches for synthetic scenarios. The '700 km/h regression trigger' must be a highly prominent, full-width Red (error color) button with bold warning text and an aggressive haptic confirmation. Keep it segregated from standard controls.

screens.name: Docs
screens.purpose: Validation matrix indicating which features are native-verified vs mocked/Expo-limited.
screens.layout: Two-column grid or dense list view. Each row lists a feature alongside a status chip. VALIDATED = Green 'success' pill. NOT VALIDATED (Expo limitation) = Amber 'warning' pill or Grey 'muted' pill. Strict tabular alignment using mono fonts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Rajdhani for screen titles/headers, IBM Plex Sans for general labels, and strictly IBM Plex Mono for all telemetry data, speed readouts, and timestamps.
Implement the Navigation map as a full-bleed background, with the HUD components housed in a heavily tinted (75% opacity surfaceSecondary) glass effect floating at the bottom.
Strictly adhere to the GREEN/AMBER/RED status color logic for GNSS, degraded, and dead-reckoning states. These status colors must pop against the pitch-black (#090A0C) background.
Ensure the '700 km/h regression trigger' button on the Simulation screen uses the 'error' background token (#FF1744) to signify a destructive/extreme test action.
Keep borders tight and layout rigid in the Diagnostics and Docs screens; this app should feel like precision developer tooling, not a consumer social app.
Explicitly mark native behaviors that cannot be fully replicated in Expo as 'NOT VALIDATED' in the Docs matrix, as instructed by the user.
